about-headline: The bridge between academia and Bitcoin.
about-lead: BitPolito is a student team at Politecnico di Torino and one of Italy's leading Bitcoin initiatives. We create opportunities to learn, build and connect around Bitcoin technology.
about-mission-p1: Founded four years ago, BitPolito has grown rapidly while staying focused on a deeper understanding and awareness of Bitcoin. We explore its technological and social dimensions, avoiding financial topics.
about-mission-p2: Our work spans computer science and mathematical R&D, education through courses and events, industry conferences and educational content with a scientific approach and a youthful voice.
about-mission-p3: BitGeneration, our successful lecture series for high schools, offers a solid overview of Bitcoin. Internally, members train together, contribute to FOSS projects and gain hands-on experience on challenging real-world work.
about-mission-p4: Inspired by the Cypherpunk movement, we stand for freedom, privacy and open-source principles. We collaborate with institutions, businesses and organisations to advocate the free and responsible use of technology.
about-working-title: Practical ways to partner with BitPolito.
about-working-text: We shape each collaboration around your goals, the students involved and the impact you want to create.
about-area1-item1-text: Bring a general Bitcoin topic, your company's work, or a practical workshop to the Politecnico di Torino. BitPolito members can support the session.
about-area1-item2-text: We design ad-hoc competitions around a product or service, involving Politecnico students and external members.
about-area1-item3-text: Present your company, meet talent and organise talks, stands, workshops or recruitment meetings with the University.
about-area2-item1-text: Members can investigate issues, test for bugs, explore use cases and suggest new developments alongside your ongoing work.
about-area2-item2-text: An individual member or a dedicated sub-team can work directly with your company, following requests, quality standards and deadlines.
about-area2-item3-text: We help connect companies with Politecnico students for supervised six-month internships or three-month thesis projects.
about-area3-item1-text: We promote events across our channels, distribute promo codes and create content during the event for future editions.
about-area3-item2-text: We co-create content about topics of common interest, your product or service, or the company behind it.
about-area3-item3-text: Your logo can appear on agreed media; we can mention the company in articles, podcasts, videos and physical events.
about-partnerships-text: Talk to the team about an educational event, a technical project or a media partnership.
